note: One Devotion: one player's reading of one Cognition, held in a Deeper Burn. Paragon Abilities are written for each character with their DM, so they can't be generated from a Cognition's own JSON — they live here. The shape deliberately mirrors a Cognition file: name / icon / description / savingThrow / damageType / engine are the same meta fields, `abilities` is grouped the way `verumEffects` is, and every ability carries a four-entry `tiers` ladder for Ranks I-IV. A tier is a string, or {text, card, mech} — the same tolerance a Cognition tier has. Formula shorthands: {VM} {PB} {DC} {ATK} as everywhere else, plus {{ ... }} for arithmetic over VM, PB, DC, ATK, LVL and RANK. The file name is the id: <owner>_<cognition>_devotion.json, with the owner's username, or `example` for the rules' own worked sets.
name: The Turning Year
description: The world, left to itself, doesn't stay still. It turns. While Nature burns, the air around Zeke smells of whatever season he's carrying: rain and blossom, dust and heat, leaf-rot, first frost.
pilgrimage: Zeke doesn't know Nature at Learn Full yet — it can't be his Paragon until a Pilgrimage brings it in.

engine.title: The Wheel
engine.text: While Nature is your Paragon it always holds one Season, and you can't skip one — you can only turn the wheel. In combat, the Season turns one step forward at the start of each of your turns; on the turn a Season arrives it takes effect without advancing. Lit or relit mid-fight, the wheel starts in Spring. Out of combat the wheel mirrors the world: your Season matches the true season of the land you stand in, and the Passive gives flavour and minor utility but no healing, damage or cover.
engine.card: 🌱 Spring → ☀️ Summer → 🍂 Autumn → ❄️ Winter → 🌱 · one step at the start of each of your turns
tiers: The wheel turns one Season forward at the start of each of your turns. Lit mid-fight, it starts in Spring.
When you light Nature, choose its starting Season. Once per long rest you can spend 1 minute in stillness to force the wheel to a different Season until your next long rest.
Once per Deeper Burn, when the Season would turn, you can hold it for one more turn.
Each turn the wheel turns either way — forward or back, your choice.

passive.name: The Seasons
passive.description: Each fight, he sees every Season about once. The rhythm is his tactics.
passive.text: While Nature is your Paragon it always holds one Season, and the Season decides what this Passive does. In combat a Season's effect starts when it arrives, at the start of your turn, and lasts until your next turn.

tiers.card: Radius 30 feet. Spring's healing doubles, and Summer's extra die becomes 2d8.
Autumn's enemies also can't take reactions, and Winter's cover becomes three-quarters.
